For springs in series, add their extensions. For springs in parallel between the same two plates, the extension is common and equal to the movement of the lower plate.
Check combination C: the upper two springs are in parallel with extension $0.075 \text{ m}$, and the lower spring is in series with them with extension $0.15 \text{ m}$.

Calculate $k = F/x_{total} = 1.8/0.225 = 8.0 \text{ N m}^{-1}$ with correct units. This is option C.
